::: {.block title="Relation to existing approaches"}
The Copernicus Marine 3D chlorophyll product (SOCA2024; Sauzède et al.) predicts Chl *a*
profiles with neural networks trained on BGC-Argo, from 5-band $R_{rs}$ plus physical
fields. It is weekly at 0.25°, covers only water deeper than 1000 m, and currently ends in
December 2023, before PACE. CHLA-Z asks whether daily hyperspectral PACE $R_{rs}$ adds
information, and extends the approach toward the coast.
:::
